task.description: Write test specifications and test source code for WF-02 batch 7 (DDL-04, OBP-04, ORD-03, VLD-04). Every MUST requirement in the batch must have runnable integration tests. For each requirement, cover ALL acceptance criteria from docs/requirements.yaml (DDL-04 line 11267: 6 ACs including interrupt/resume idempotency, NonIdempotentBackfill rejection, ROW EXCLUSIVE per batch, 5s batch slowdown halving, 10-iteration stall escalation, plat_migration_state recording; OBP-04 line 11940: 6 ACs including hysteresis oscillation, reopen at low-water + event, flapping defect detection, 100-refusals/min escalation, 300s paging, per-tenant keying; ORD-03 line 12024: 6 ACs including out-of-order silent rollback, cursor advance, 0-updated-rows double-apply guard, typed error rollback, gap sweeper to DEAD+DLQ, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; VLD-04 line 13240: 5 ACs including 422 on draft findings, 422 at promotion submit, re-verify on compiler version change, 5s ValidationTimeout, DEFINITION_VALIDATED/DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED events). Note: BACKEND-DEV already wrote 3 integration tests (ddl04/obp04/vld04) - review, extend, and complete them plus write ORD-03 tests, wired into the test suites. Write specs to tests/specs/ and test source under tests/. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests without a documented counterpart.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec exists in tests/specs/ for each of DDL-04, OBP-04, ORD-03, VLD-04
Every acceptance criterion of each requirement has a runnable integration test
Tests are wired into the build.zig test steps (or an existing suite) so TEST-RUNNER can run them
No MUST requirement's tests are deferred (SkipZigTest) without a documented counterpart
Fixtures are isolated (per-test tenant isolation per ENV-02 helpers)

result.summary: Test specs + integration suites for DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04 written and wired into build.zig. 4 specs, 4 new integration suites + named modules. obp04-gate 6/6; ord03 8/9; ddl04-backfill 5/6; vld04-gate 4/7. Fixed 4 BACKEND-DEV implementation defects that blocked compilation/event appends (public.events->tenant events via plat_event_idempotency sidecar, error-set-discarded, deriveLowWater static call, fmt). Remaining failures are genuine implementation defects filed as BLOCKER issues: ORD-03 sweeper predicate missing +1, DDL-04 AC5 stall policy unreachable, VLD-04 finding-path heap corruption. zig build check 0, zig build test 0, lint_test_isolation 0.

issues.description: ORD-03 AC5: sweepStalledCorrelations predicate is p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq (missing +1) - a slow-but-present correlation is wrongly dead-lettered. TC-ORD-03-AC5-non-stalled-not-swept fails. Predicate must be p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq + 1.

DDL-04 AC5: runBackfill breaks on the first 0-row iteration before the stall check, so the 10-iteration stall policy is unreachable. TC-DDL-04-AC5-stall-escalation fails. Zero-row break must only fire when rows_remaining==0.

VLD-04: runSemanticGate finding path corrupts heap memory - persistVerdict writes garbage compiler_version on findings (clean pass writes correct value; verified) and AC3-stale/AC4-timeout segfault. Needs ISSUE-FIXER root-cause in the validateDefinition finding path.
recordBatchProgress hardcodes backfill_batch_size=5000 and never writes the terminal applied/failed status to plat_migration_state.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 3b); BLOCKER defects to ORCH for ISSUE-FIXER dispatch
